{{Quote|This reminds me when we had three nights to prepare for the Senate hearing to rescue Bromlarch's planetary aqueduct system.''"<br />"''And together, we saved a people from total drought and famine. I don't think either of us got any sleep that whole week, let alone ate anything.|Padmé Amidala and Rush Clovis|<ref name="TROC">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref>}}
'''Bromlarch''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Vish sector/Legends|Vish sector]] that was linked to a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] aqueduct system prior to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] jointly prepared a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] hearing to rescue Bromlarch's system, which was effective in saving a population from drought and famine.<ref name="TROC" />
